book.name: DJAWUNAWALAŊUWUY DHÄWU
book.title: JONAH Ḻakarama yukurra Djawunanha, ŋunhi ŋayi yukurrana marŋgithina Godku, ŋunhi ŋayinydja mel‐wuyunamirrina God

content: Djawuna bukumirriyaŋala Garraywala nhanukalayŋuwala waŋarrwala, ga bitjarrana ŋayi yukurrana bukumirriyaŋalanydja gam'.

content.text: ŋarra marrtjina bala dhuryurrunana, ŋunhana wal'ŋu ŋoylilina gapulili.
Ŋuriŋi gapuyunydja gäŋalana yukurrana, wäkwakmaraŋalana ŋarranha bala ga lili,
ga ŋuriŋi ḏowuyu ŋarranha buku‐ḻumbakmaraŋala yukurrana.
Ŋarra guyaŋinanydja yanapi nhe ŋarranha djuy'yunana‐wala,
‘Ŋarra yurru yakana biyapul Garraywu Buṉbunydja nhäma;
Yakana biyapul gärri nhanukala ḻatju'lilinydja wal'ŋu wäŋalili,’
Ŋunhala ŋoyŋura gapuŋuranydja ŋarra marrtjina ŋoy‐wuḻkthurrunana,
Ga ŋayinydja ŋarranha garrpirana marrtjina djewulyunydja,
garrpi'‐garrpiranydja ŋarranha muḻkurrnha ŋunhala djinawa' gapuŋura, ŋoyŋurana wal'ŋu.
Ŋarra marrtjina dhuryurrunanydja ŋunhana munatha'lilina wal'ŋu,
biyaku ŋuli ŋarranha gäŋalanydja marrtjina ŋunhana rakunymirriwalana ŋayambalklili.
Marrkapmirri Garray, nhenydja ŋarrakuna dhuwala Waŋarr;
nhe ŋarranha walŋakuŋala bitjarra djaw'yurrunana rakunydhinyamirriŋuru romŋuru.
Ŋarra buku‐dhumukthina guyaŋinanydja yanapi ŋarra rakunydhinyana,
Ga ŋunhili nhokala Buṉbuŋuranydja nhe ŋäkulana ŋarranha Garray,
Wiripunydja yolŋu walala yukurra buku‐ŋal'yun maḏayin'kuna,
djämana‐wala yurru ŋurikiy dhärukpuynydja ŋunhi ŋarra dhawu'mirriyaŋala nhuna ŋäthili.
waŋganydhuna yana nhepina ŋuli walŋakumanydja yolŋunha.”

content: Ga bitjarra ŋayi Djawuna waŋananydja, ŋayaŋuyunydja bukumirriyaŋala yukurrana Garraynha.

Yo, Djawunawunydja ŋunhi ḻurrkun'nha munha ŋunhiliyi guḻunŋuranydja guyawala, bala ŋayi Garraynydja waŋana ŋurikala guyawalanydja, bala dhunupana ŋunhi guyanydja waṉḏina, djunamana yana gäŋalana ŋanya, bala dhawaṯmaraŋalana raŋililina.
